entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT the supplied ORIGINAL pixel-art merchant into ONE 8-direction turnaround sheet of the EXACT SAME character. The supplied original is authoritative: preserve his recognizable face, narrow eye shape, long/slightly tilted brown hat crown and wide brim, dark full beard, red neck scarf, blue inner shirt, mustard coat reaching thighs, brown belt/trousers/boots, and shoulder satchel with yellow buckle. Maintain EXACT original head-to-body proportions and clothing shapes/materials. Do NOT redesign, do NOT make a fatter round head, do NOT make the legs shorter, do NOT exaggerate chibi. Reconstruct only surfaces newly revealed by rotation. Eight FULL-BODY standing idle rotations, crisp pixel art with the same coarse square pixel clusters, original palette and original outline. No walking poses, hands resting naturally. EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows grid, eight equal cells, each figure center aligned and same height/baseline with generous 15% transparent padding. Top row: (1) front SOUTH face straight toward viewer; (2) SOUTH-EAST facing DOWN-RIGHT, nose points RIGHT, right-facing front three-quarter; (3) EAST right profile, nose points RIGHT; (4) NORTH-EAST facing UP-RIGHT, back three-quarter, only right edge of face possibly visible. Bottom row: (5) NORTH true back, NO visible face; (6) NORTH-WEST facing UP-LEFT, back three-quarter; (7) WEST left profile, nose points LEFT; (8) SOUTH-WEST facing DOWN-LEFT, reproduce supplied original orientation/design as faithfully as possible. DIRECTIONS ARE SCREEN COMPASS. Keep shoulder satchel on the same anatomical side throughout rotations. Camera elevated ~30deg in all cells consistent with original. Transparent actual alpha, no cast shadow, no ground, no backdrop, no text/numbers/labels/gridlines/watermarks. Landscape2:1 sheet. This is an orientation edit of original, not a new character design.

EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows, six evenly spaced full-body idle figures, consistent height and baseline, 15% transparent padding within every cell, neither body nor shoes cropped. Top row: (1) SOUTH front facing viewer; (2) EAST true right profile, nose points RIGHT, body facing RIGHT; (3) NORTH-EAST back-three-quarter facing upper-right, back mostly visible. Bottom row: (4) NORTH true back with NO visible face; (5) NORTH-WEST back-three-quarter facing upper-left, back mostly visible; (6) WEST true left profile, nose points LEFT, body facing LEFT. Screen compass directions. Camera 30deg elevated consistent with supplied reference. Same neutral standing idle stance in every view, no walking. EXACT original pixel-art style, no gradients/antialiasing, no finer painterly texture or muddy noise. Preserve accessory anatomical side in all new rotations. Landscape canvas, genuine transparent alpha, NO background/ground/shadow/text/labels/numbers/gridlines/watermark. This is a turnaround edit, not a new character design.
